title: Pocket Beacons
description: Pocket Beacons is a mod that adds a portable beacon item for selecting and applying effects for on the go beacon usage.
body:
# Pocket Beacons *Never Leave Your Buffs Behind!* ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow) ![Author](https://img.shields.io/badge/Author-MrCrabTAB-purple)
--- ## Gallery
### GUI ### Crafting Recipe
--- ## Features - **Portable Beacon** — a compact inventory-sized beacon you can take anywhere - **Choose your effect** — Haste, Speed, or Jump Boost --- ## Fuel & Duration | Fuel | Duration | |------|----------| | Iron Ingot | 2 minutes | | Gold Ingot | 3 minutes | | Diamond | 4 minutes | | Emerald | 5 minutes | | Netherite Ingot | 10 minutes | --- ## How to Use 1. Craft a **Pocket Beacon** 2. Right-click to open the GUI 3. Insert a fuel item into the slot 4. Select your desired effect 5. Click **Apply** 6. Enjoy your buff! --- ## Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 2. Drop [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [UILib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-lib), and `pocket-beacons.jar` into your `mods` folder --- ## Dependencies [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) [UILib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-lib) --- ## Compatibility | | | |---|---| | Minecraft | `1.21.11` | | Fabric Loader | `>=0.18.5` | | Java | `>=21` | --- ## License This mod is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). ---
